g.text: Rent or buy your way in.
Prices are set per token on the admin TOKENS tab.
Save sends the shop's new list; the screen on the block changes at once.
Admins see a SETTINGS key on the shop.

a token in; the picked slot sets its
tab's kind), its place, and whether this
shop sells its rent, its full access or
both. The prices and the rent length are
the token's own, set once on the admin
panel's TOKENS tab, so every shop and
Every shop block has its own list. COPY
